# ATS018 — CNPE: GitOps and Continuous Delivery (Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer)

[![Liberapay](https://img.shields.io/badge/Liberapay-Support_Astrona.io-F6C915?logo=liberapay&logoColor=black&style=for-the-badge)](https://liberapay.com/Astrona.io)

Training material covering the Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer (CNPE) GitOps and Continuous Delivery domain: packaging applications with Kustomize, continuous delivery from Git with Argo CD and Flux, continuous integration pipelines with Tekton that hand a new image to a GitOps repository, and progressive delivery with Argo Rollouts and Flagger. Each module pairs a layered reader with an ungraded hands-on playground on a local kind cluster with an in-cluster Gitea server. Each section closes with an integration capstone.

This course covers the **GitOps and Continuous Delivery** domain of the Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer (CNPE) exam, **25% of the exam**.

Everything lives under `sections/`. Each section is a set of modules, and each module is:

- a **landing page** (`course.md`) plus, where the subject needs it, ordered **deep-dive parts** (`course-0N-*.md`), woven with hands-on "Try it" checkpoints and Mermaid diagrams;
- an ungraded **playground** — a throwaway environment to explore in;

Each section ends with a **capstone lab** combining its modules and a knowledge-check quiz.

[`astrona.yaml`](astrona.yaml) is the manifest: every section, module, reading, playground, lab and capstone in the order they are meant to be taken.

Everything targets **kind 0.33.0**, **kind_node_image kindest/node:v1.35.8**, **kubernetes 1.35**, **kustomize 5.7.1 (embedded in kubectl 1.35)**, **helm 4.3.0 (bootstrap plumbing only, not taught)**, **argocd 3.5.4**, **flux 2.9.6**, **tekton_pipelines 1.17.0**, **tekton_triggers 0.36.4**, **tkn 0.46.1**, **argo_rollouts 1.10.0**, **flagger 1.45.0**, **istio 1.31.1**, **kube_prometheus_stack_chart 92.3.0**, **gitea 28.1.0-rootless (plumbing only, not taught)**, **podinfo 6.15.0**, **go_httpbin 2.25.0** on `kind`.

## How to work through it

1. Open the section's `README.md` for the map.
2. Read each module's `course.md`, then its deep-dive parts in order.
3. Boot the module playground and run the "Try it" checkpoints alongside the text.
4. Solve the section capstone without looking at the walkthrough.
5. Take the section quiz, then the final domain quiz once every section is done.
